builds.name: Brave
builds.desc:
Setsuna lacks the Atk to normally use a Brave weapon the way they're normally used where a unit throws out Spd in favor of raw Atk. However, Setsuna makes up for this with her notably high Spd stat. Brave users don't usually care for Spd, but in Setsuna's case, she's capable of easily quadruple hitting a large number of heroes.
Brave Bow+ provides the most damage out of any bow on average due to the frequency she can quad (vs. just doubling with other bows). Relying on the quads though makes her susceptible to unreliable performance due to inconsistent Spd (eg. Speed IVs, Speed Buffs, Speed Debuffs, etc). On top of that, investing everything into her ability to quad not only makes her prone to being worthless against enemies she can't quad (eg. Fast Red Sword lords) but also makes her unable to dent high Def units. The +Atk IV aids in giving her an additional 6 damage on normal Brave Bow+ doubles and 12 damage on quads. Speed IV is less efficient because most of the enemeies she's unable to quad without +Spd IV will typically have lower defenses. This means she will usually kill these units with just the double hit of the Brave Bow+ (eg. Linde). Not only that, but a +Spd IV and less damage will make her match ups worse for her when she fails to double. With the +Atk IV instead of +Spd IV, she's still capable of quadding most high Def units and now packs more punch.
Life and Death is selected as her A-skill as it gives her the highest Atk for an A-slot passive (except against Death Blow), but also gives +5 Spd to negate the -5 Spd from the Brave weapon. This keeps her speed high enough to allow her to quad a majority of units. In the B-slot, since one goal of this build is to not overly rely on quad-hitting, Swordbreaker is chosen instead of the usual Desperation seen in other common Quadsuna builds. This allows her to quad the units she had the most trouble quadding before such as Lucina and Ryoma. In this build, she nets wins on both of these match ups. Note that with a +Spd IV, Setsuna kills Lucina but fails to kill Ryoma, exemplifying the need for +Atk IV.
Finally, we run Luna because while she doesn't have trouble killing most units, when she does, it's usually against units with very high Def. The lower cooldown Moonbow may seem attractive but does not provide enough of a defense reduction to kill these high Def units compared to Luna.
C-slot passive and Assists skills are flexible and dependent on what a player's team requires. For this setup though, Hones on the C-skill and positioning skills for the assists are highly suggested.

builds.name: Guarding Archer
builds.desc:
This build has the sole purpose of taking advantage of the new Guard Bow+. With her new Bow, she can have high defensive stats when attacked during the enemy phase. With Guard Bow+ and Distant Def, in the A slot and as a seal, Setsuna can reach 40 defense and 41 resistance when attacked by a foe using bow, dagger, magic, or staff. This makes Setsuna a powerful enemy phase tank, especially with possible buffs from teammates.
An issue with this build is Setsuna's naturally low attack, even with +Atk/-Hp ivs. Yet, with her high defensive stats she can deal massive damage with Iceberg as her special. If you have access to a unit with Infantry Pulse, then Glacies would be a better choice to increase her damage output.
Any assist skill can work, with Reposition and Swap being most useful for movement.
This build is centered around her A Skill being Distant Def. While this is a rare skill, I feel it is the best one for her with this weapon.
For a B Skill, there are a few options. Bowbreaker is an option that allows for less SP grinding, but other breaker skills could be useful as well. However with the restrictions of this build, breaker skills used should only be those that counter ranged foes. Another option for a B Skill is Cancel Affinity. This skill makes Setsuna a very powerful counter to raventome mages, especially with her high resistance.
Any C Skill that assists those on Setsuna's team can work. Hone skills are most likely the optimal choice for this build seeing as it is heavily reliant on the combat occurring during the enemy phase, so skills like Threaten Def won't have much of an affect.
This build fills a very niche role: allowing Setsuna to become a ranged tank, while sacrificing the damage output of Quadsuna builds and forcing all of her battles to occur during the enemy phase. With the new weapon refinery feature Guard Bow+ can gain more attack, speed, or resistance, which are the upgrades I would recommend.
The Guard Bow+ with this build allows Setsuna to lure her foes into a trap, instead of falling into one herself.
